Title: Mark single attendance with valid employeeId, absent, and date
Description: Verify that marking a single attendance record with valid employeeId, absent status, and date returns 200 OK and the saved attendance record
Pre-Conditions: Employee with employeeId exists in the system
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with JSON body containing employeeId, absent, and date
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify response body contains attendance record with matching employeeId, absent, and date
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with attendance record reflecting employeeId=123, absent=true, date=2024-06-01

Title: Mark single attendance with valid employeeId and absent, but no date provided
Description: Verify that marking a single attendance record with valid employeeId and absent but no date uses current date and returns 200 OK
Pre-Conditions: Employee with employeeId exists in the system
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with JSON body containing employeeId and absent but no date
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify response body contains attendance record with matching employeeId, absent, and date equal to current date
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with attendance record reflecting employeeId=456, absent=false, date=current system date

Title: Mark single attendance with missing employeeId
Description: Verify that marking attendance without employeeId returns 400 Bad Request with appropriate error message
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with JSON body missing employeeId
Verify response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify response body contains message 'employeeId and absent required'
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'employeeId and absent required'

Title: Mark single attendance with missing absent field
Description: Verify that marking attendance without absent field returns 400 Bad Request with appropriate error message
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with JSON body missing absent field
Verify response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify response body contains message 'employeeId and absent required'
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'employeeId and absent required'

Title: Mark batch attendance with valid list of attendance records
Description: Verify that marking batch attendance with valid list of attendance DTOs returns 200 OK with correct counts and saved records
Pre-Conditions: Employees with employeeIds in payload exist in the system
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with JSON array of valid attendance DTOs
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify response body contains savedCount equal to number of valid records
Verify presentCount and absentCount are correct based on input
Verify savedRecords array contains attendance records matching input
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with savedCount=2, presentCount=1, absentCount=1, savedRecords matching input, invalidEntries: []

Title: Mark batch attendance with some invalid entries missing absent field
Description: Verify that batch marking attendance with some DTOs missing absent field returns 200 OK with invalidEntries containing employeeIds of invalid records
Pre-Conditions: Employees with employeeIds in payload exist in the system
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with JSON array containing some DTOs missing absent field
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify invalidEntries contains employeeIds of invalid DTOs
Verify savedCount equals number of valid records
Verify presentCount and absentCount counts are correct
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with savedCount=1, presentCount=0, absentCount=1, invalidEntries: [202]

Title: Mark batch attendance with empty payload
Description: Verify that sending empty list to batch attendance endpoint returns 400 Bad Request with appropriate error message
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with empty JSON array
Verify response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify response body contains message 'payload is empty'
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'payload is empty'

Title: Mark batch attendance with null payload
Description: Verify that sending null as payload to batch attendance endpoint returns 400 Bad Request with appropriate error message
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with null body
Verify response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify response body contains message 'payload is empty'
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'payload is empty'

Title: Mark batch attendance with some DTOs missing employeeId
Description: Verify that batch attendance with some DTOs missing employeeId skips those entries and does not add them to invalidEntries
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with JSON array containing some DTOs missing employeeId
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify invalidEntries does not contain employeeIds for DTOs missing employeeId
Verify savedCount equals number of valid records
Verify presentCount and absentCount counts are correct
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with savedCount=1, presentCount=1, absentCount=0, invalidEntries: []

Title: Mark single attendance updates employee counters correctly when changing from absent to present
Description: Verify that marking attendance for existing record changes employee totalAbsent and totalPresent counters correctly when absent status changes from true to false
Pre-Conditions: Employee has existing attendance record marked absent for given date
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with employeeId, absent=false, and date matching existing absent record
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify employee totalAbsent decreased by 1 and totalPresent increased by 1
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with attendance record updated and employee counters adjusted accordingly

Title: Mark single attendance updates employee counters correctly when changing from present to absent
Description: Verify that marking attendance for existing record changes employee totalAbsent and totalPresent counters correctly when absent status changes from false to true
Pre-Conditions: Employee has existing attendance record marked present for given date
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with employeeId, absent=true, and date matching existing present record
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify employee totalPresent decreased by 1 and totalAbsent increased by 1
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with attendance record updated and employee counters adjusted accordingly
